## Example 2.6(c) · Billie joins the model {#fgt2-ferris-shift .trig-lesson .application-lesson .application-dense}

**c)** Billie is in another carriage. The height, $B(t)$, in metres above the ground of the top of her carriage is given by:

$$B(t)=c-k\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{24}(t-6)\right),$$

where $c$ and $k$ are the values found in part (a).

Drag the shared time slider from 0 to 48 seconds to see the height of each carriage and the corresponding graph points. Matching orange arrows measure Anna's height from ground level on the wheel and from height zero on the graph.
